crossRefs.note: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

parallels.note: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

translations.web: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
translations.bsb: And when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down.
translations.kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
translations.asv: And when they were gone up into the boat, the wind ceased.
